title: Delete a Btrfs subvolume
summary: Remove a subvolume from a Btrfs file system. Ensure the subvolume is not mounted before deleting.

steps.explain: Delete the subvolume at the specified path. Replace <SUBVOL_PATH> with the path to the subvolume.

placeholders.name: SUBVOL_PATH
placeholders.description: Path to the subvolume to delete

warnings: Deleting a mounted subvolume can lead to filesystem inconsistencies.
Data inside the subvolume will be lost.

rollback.explain: If the subvolume was a snapshot, you might be able to restore it if you have another snapshot or backup. Otherwise, data is lost.
